reviews.text: Kush Paradise is hands down one of the best spots in Phuket for cannabis lovers. The shop has a wide variety of high-quality products, with a super chill vibe and a nice café-style setup. The staff are really friendly, knowledgeable, and always happy to explain and recommend what suits you best. Great prices, great atmosphere, and a perfect place to relax and enjoy – definitely worth visiting again!
